title: Multimodal Hate Speech Detection from Bengali Memes and Texts

bias_targets.methodology: Binary classification of multimodal Bengali text and image data (memes) to detect hateful content and prejudice targeting religious identities using deep learning and transformer-based models.
Binary classification of multimodal Bengali text and image data (memes) to detect hateful content and prejudice targeting political identities using deep learning and transformer-based models.

Binary classification of multimodal Bengali text and image data (memes) to detect hateful content and prejudice targeting specific geopolitical groups using deep learning and transformer-based models.
Binary classification of multimodal Bengali text and image data (memes) to detect gender-abusive hate speech using deep learning and transformer-based models.
